invariants.rationale: inputRecords should be provided to perform bulk inserts; most operations assume a non-null list.
The instantTime is expected to be a valid, non-empty String representing a commit instant.
The table must exist in order to perform operations relating to the bulk insert.
The configuration must be present to determine the behavior of the bulk insert operation.
The executor is required to update index and perform necessary actions as part of the commit logic.
